record.title: Austria–Liechtenstein: Mauren and Schellenberg pandemic gate closures
record.scope: Two local land crossings; not the entire bilateral frontier
record.movement: Traffic through the two named posts
record.exceptions: Exempt commuters, goods, emergency traffic and transit used Ruggell or Schaanwald.
record.imposing_authority: Austrian authorities, as reported by Liechtenstein government
record.enforcement: Closure order and later report of continuing closure; no independently observed first or final passage established.
record.relationship: Related to wider Austrian controls and Swiss customs-area measures (EU024); distinct authority and posts. Do not count as a separate national decision.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no status extrapolation to 21 October 2026
record.context: Local gate closures accompanied broader Austrian entry conditions. The 16 March public-transport suspension is a different measure.
record.uncertainty: 18 March is the announced Austrian gate-closure date. A mirrored customs list gives 17 March; the discrepancy may concern authority or implementation and is unresolved. June 4 removal of Austrian checks does not by itself prove these posts physically reopened.
